entities.summary: Zeyad Eashash is a Jordanian amateur boxer who won silver at the 2022 Asian Amateur Boxing Championships. He represented Jordan at the delayed 2020 Summer Olympics in Tokyo and the 2024 Summer Olympics in Paris.
